The hidden economics of free shipping

Somebody always pays. Usually it is not who you think.

Retailers advertise free shipping because shoppers react strongly to delivery fees, even small ones.

The cost does not disappear. It is folded into product prices, membership fees, or thinner margins.

Smaller sellers often feel the pressure most, because they cannot negotiate the same rates with carriers.
